name: @mirage-cli/core
description: Wrap any Commander.js CLI for in-process execution. ALS-isolated, streaming stdout/stderr, ByteSource stdin, Cloudflare Worker-compatible.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outdir=dist --external commander && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:worker: wrangler dev --port 3003 --local --log-level=warn & sleep 3 && bun tests/drive-worker.ts; ec=$?; kill %1 2>/dev/null; exit $ec
